provenance: Original author-created teaching case. No actual participants, empirical measurements or external dataset.

design.target: finite-population effect of assigned interface on completion among these eight people
design.assignment_time: relative day 0, before interface delivery and outcomes
design.held_fixed: stated prices, available final options and information
design.outcome: binary completion of the session by the end of relative day 7
design.outcome_availability: end of relative day 7 for every person
design.units: 0 or 1 per person; differences are completion-rate units
assumptions: The interface is delivered exactly as assigned; subsequent adoption remains voluntary.
Potential outcomes depend on own assignment only; no interference.
No missing outcomes; the measurement rule is the same in both arms.
All subsets of four people have probability 1/70, independent of their fixed potential outcomes.
The absolute mean-difference statistic and test direction are selected before outcome access.

oracle_warning: The following potential outcomes are deliberately supplied synthetic truth for a separate instructional audit. They would not both be observable for any actual participant. They are not used by the sharp-null test.
